reason: Only forward fix is the SvelteKit 2->3 migration (fixAvailable points at @sveltejs/kit@3.0.1). Confirmed via SvelteKit's own migration guide that v3 removes the $lib alias (replacing it with a package.json-declared #lib import, requiring a rename across ~98 files in src/), relocates $env/$app/environment modules, removes $app/stores, and requires Node >=22.17, TypeScript v6 and Vite v8 -- a full toolchain migration, not a dependency bump. A prior attempt at this migration broke $lib resolution and PUBLIC_* env var resolution. Severity is low (CVSS 0): the advisory is about out-of-bounds characters in a cookie name/path/domain, which this app never sets by hand. Re-evaluate once the SvelteKit 3 migration is undertaken as its own tracked project.

Vulnerable esbuild is bundled by svelte-i18n@4.0.1 -- the latest published release -- as its own direct dependency (node_modules/svelte-i18n/node_modules/esbuild); no newer svelte-i18n release exists that updates it, so there is no forward fix. npm's only reported fix path is downgrading to svelte-i18n@3.7.1, which predates the v4 API this app's src/lib/i18n/ already relies on across 46 files -- a downgrade, not a fix. The advisory describes esbuild's own dev server accepting cross-origin requests; this app never invokes svelte-i18n's bundled CLI (bin: svelte-i18n -> dist/cli.js is unreferenced by any npm script here), so that esbuild copy is never actually run. Re-evaluate if a future svelte-i18n release bumps its esbuild dependency.

Fixed only in minimatch>=11.0.1, but every parent pins minimatch ^10: eslint@10.14.0 (latest), @eslint/config-array@0.23.5 (latest) and @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree@8.72.1 (latest). Upgrading the parents can't reach the fix, and npm's suggested 'fixes' are downgrades (eslint@4.0.0, typescript-eslint@8.14.0, eslint-plugin-svelte@1.1.2, eslint-config-prettier@6.15.0, @eslint/js@9.39.5). Forcing minimatch@11 under these parents isn't allowed by this project's policy. Dev-only lint tooling that only matches globs from this repo's own config, so the ReDoS input is never attacker-controlled. Re-evaluate when eslint/typescript-eslint move to minimatch 11.

No patched deepmerge exists: the advisory covers >=4.2.0 <=4.3.1, and 4.3.1 is the latest release. It's pulled in by @sveltejs/vite-plugin-svelte@7.3.1 (latest), svelte-i18n@4.0.1 (latest) and @rollup/plugin-node-resolve (via @sveltejs/adapter-node). npm's suggested 'fixes' are adapter-node@6 (requires the SvelteKit 3 migration, see GHSA-pxg6-pf52-xh8x) or a downgrade to svelte-i18n@3.1.0. Those packages merge build config and translation dictionaries from this repo, not user input. Re-evaluate when a patched deepmerge ships.
